visual.general_description: PRISMA-style literature selection flow chart with printed record counts from identification to six included studies.
visual.detailed_description: A white-background flow chart of rectangular boxes joined by black arrows, with four rounded light-blue vertical side labels reading "Identification", "Screening", "Eligibility" and "Included". Under Identification, two boxes side by side read "Records identified through database searching (n = 440)" and "Additional records identified through other sources (n = 104)"; both arrows lead down to "Records after duplicates removed (n = 521)". Under Screening, "Records screened (n = 521)" has a side arrow to "Records excluded (n = 512)". Under Eligibility, "Full-text articles assessed for eligibility (n = 9)" has a side arrow to a box reading "Full-text articles excluded (n = 3)" with the lines "n = 1 no respiratory depression" and "n = 2 no Severe Neurological Impairment (SNI)". Under Included, the box reads "Studies included in qualitative synthesis (n = 6)". It contains no patient images, plotted data or clinical measurements.

clinical_significance.statement: The text reports 440 database articles, 104 hand-searched articles and 521 remaining after duplicate removal, with six articles included in the scoping review.

evidence.quote: The electronic database search yielded 440 articles. An additional 104 articles were identified through hand searching, and 521 articles remained after duplicates were removed.
